publisher_reference.rounding: round each weighted category percentage to a whole number using half-up, then add code 1 and code 3

method.base: Rows where WP22443 is non-null; DK and refused remain in the denominator.
method.weighting: PROJWT population-projection weight; weighted category sum divided by the sum of PROJWT over all non-missing WP22443 rows.
method.personal_harm: The publisher's personally-harmed measure adds rounded code 1 (yes, personally) and code 3 (both).
method.rounding: floor(weighted_percentage + 0.5 + 1e-9), matching the pinned publisher reproduction code.

limitations: WP22443 is self-reported serious harm in the past two years, not a laboratory measure of contamination or drinking-water compliance.
The global weighted estimate is not a Georgian prevalence estimate and cannot replace NEA or NFA sample-level water-quality data.
The publisher's reported 13 percent is the sum of separately rounded weighted categories 1 and 3; it is not the rounded unweighted share or a direct contaminant prevalence.
